messages:
anya: Quick sync — I'm prototyping a new Grafana dashboard to visualize topology-aware slotting across the GPU fleet. Goal: surface fragmentation, rack-locality misses, and ambient/room temp correlations so schedulers can make better placement decisions.

mike: love it. can you sketch the main panels you want?

anya: thinking: 1) slot utilization heatmap by rack+host (time series small multiples), 2) scatter of memory fragmentation vs. vram free, 3) % of jobs that had cross-rack mmap fallback, 4) ambient temp vs fan RPM latency overlay, 5) SLO burn chart for 99p latency for short vs long sequences.

leo: for (3) we need a metric to flag "cross-rack fallback" — extractor already emits labels when allocator falls back, `allocator_fallback_total{reason="rack_locality"}`. use that as rate() over 5m and join by job_id.

jess: also add a small inset table for busiest models per rack — that helped during the last spike. even just top5 model_name with tokens/sec.

anya: good call. promqls I'm prototyping: 
```promql
rate(allocator_fallback_total{reason="rack_locality"}[5m])

sum by (rack) (node_gpu_memory_used_bytes) / sum by (rack) (node_gpu_memory_total_bytes)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,job_type))
```

samir: qualifier: for memory fragmentation, grab `gpu_free_contiguous_bytes` from nvml exporter — it's what showed the stuck-alloc edge case last week. thresholding that per-model size helps signal failures before OOM retries.

mike: any plans for alerting? we should avoid noisy alerts. maybe a composite alert: when rack fallback rate > 0.5% AND 99p latency for short jobs > 300ms for > 10min.

anya: exactly. draft alert: `expr: (sum(rate(allocator_fallback_total{reason="rack_locality"}[10m])) by (rack) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[10m])) by (rack)) > 0.005 and histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) > 0.3` then for 10m. add annotation with affected racks and top model.

leo: one more thing — ambient sensors drift. normalize ambient by 7-day rolling median per rack before correlating to fan RPM to avoid seasonal bias. we already export `ambient_temp_c`. use `moving_average` in promQL with `avg_over_time(ambient_temp_c[7d])` baseline.

jess: can the dashboard include a link to the slot-assignment planner page and a button to run a quick `repack`? Ops will want one-click remediation for urgent hot racks.

anya: yes — we'll add an action link to the console: `/ops/repack?rack=$rack&dry_run=1`. also include a small playbook panel: steps to validate repack, expected downtime, rollback.

sre-bot: deploybot: grafana/dashboard/update queued by anya for staging. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/grafana/dashboards/+/2345

samir: when you push to staging, please tag me. I'll run the synthetic workload against the topology-aware scheduler to verify metrics. I'll also run the ambient stress test to validate fan curve correlations.

anya: will do. plan: design panels today, push JSON to repo, and open a PR for staging. target to get feedback by EOD tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: thumbs. if we get noisy alerts after staging, let's tune with `for: 20m` and add suppression for maintenance windows.

jess: small UX note — prefer compact sparkline rows for racks so the dashboard fits on a single screen for triage.

anya: noted. I'll build with repeat panels and compact rows. I'll post PR link here once ready.
